scores.evidence: Phase 1 "Depends on: V0"; Phase 2 "Depends on: Phase 1 and the health-metrics dependency"; Phase 3 "V1 and V2 before wave 1; V3 before wave 2; V4 before wave 3"
scores.rationale: Each phase names its dependency and gates on validation proof before dependents proceed, going from substrate to contracts to delivery to migration to decommission.

scores.evidence: One real commit to a low-risk, stateless internal service with a willing team. The response is that service running the new version in production.
scores.rationale: Phase 0 is a real end-to-end prod path with deploy, observe and rollback before any features.

scores.evidence: Default | Assumption | Validated by | Flip condition — e.g. "Pull (GitOps with Argo CD)... Flip: Targets are not Kubernetes"
scores.rationale: Irreversible decisions are tabulated with reversibility class, default, assumption, validation and flip condition, plus missing inputs listed.

scores.evidence: Tasks, widest rework first: 1. Freeze the artifact contract... Phase 3 (smallest exposure first)
scores.rationale: Phase 1 orders the widest-impact contract and template work before leaf dry-runs, and migration waves are ordered by exposure.

scores.evidence: 0: OIDC identity for one namespace; secret masking in logs | 1: Signing plus admission enforce; scans | 4: Rotate every legacy secret
scores.rationale: Concrete security work appears in every phase starting with Phase 0.

scores.evidence: Pipeline events and Argo sync events go into the central log and trace system (OpenTelemetry), tagged with commit SHA.
scores.rationale: Observability is built in Phase 0 and has specific content in each later phase.

scores.evidence: Pipeline-as-code; pinned runner image | Versioned templates; digest-pinned images; SBOM | All deploy state in the GitOps repo
scores.rationale: Reproducibility has concrete treatment in every phase.

scores.evidence: Old pipeline kept as fallback; git-revert rollback | Template version pinning | Automatic rollback | Per-service fallback | Restore rehearsed
scores.rationale: Failure handling and rollback are specified in every phase, with break-glass and per-phase rollback entries.
The plan explicitly declares the AI layer not applicable and adds no AI components.

scores.evidence: Merge queue: when main-branch breakages exceed 2 per week on any shared repo.
scores.rationale: Deferred items are listed with concrete pull-forward triggers.

note: Very strong plan that meets every rubric dimension with concrete content, with no significant gaps.
